# Interaction Index

Interaction Index is a dense, monochrome React component and interaction system for product interfaces.

## Documentation routes

- /#introduction - system overview and behavior signature
- /#installation - registry and stylesheet setup
- /#foundations - color, typography, spacing, motion, and Component DNA
- /#button - component documentation begins with Button; the sidebar lists all 35 components
- /#patterns - authored interaction patterns
- /#accessibility - keyboard, focus, motion, contrast, and manual review
- /#browser-support - browser and viewport support policy
- /#security - vulnerability reporting and supported versions
- /#contributing - contribution and review requirements
- /#releases - versioning, evidence, deprecation, and support windows
- /#licensing - MIT permissions and third-party responsibilities

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest registry add @index=https://minwookshin.github.io/interaction-index/r/{name}.json
npx shadcn@latest add @index/button
```

Installed component source imports the shared contract and its scoped stylesheet. The complete-system item also provides `styles/interaction-index.css` as the application-root base entry.
